recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white portrait of a man, featuring a bright, blown-out background and deep black clothing. The composition is defined by extreme letter spacing at the top and a circular typographic arrangement on the subject's shoulder.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key background vs. low-key subject clothing
Linear horizontal text at top vs. circular text on the bottom left
Tight facial crop vs. expansive negative space on the left margin
coreInvariants: Pure black and white palette with no mid-tone grays in the background
Extreme character tracking in the top header
Circular text path that follows the curve of the shoulder

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly right of center, cropped from the chest up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, centered horizontally in the right two-thirds of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top horizontal text, moves down to the eyes, then follows the shoulder line to the circular text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A thick vertical black bar on the far left edge, balanced by a white void behind the subject's head.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep matte black for clothing and hair shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neutral gray skin tones with high-contrast highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on extreme tracking and path manipulation

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in white space above head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in contrasting colors (black vs. white) and contrasting paths (linear vs. circular).
graphicDevices: Vertical black border on the left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and monolinear weight.
Provides the sharp geometric terminals and wide open counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with 80s-style hair, wearing a black jacket. The background should be blown-out white. Include a solid black vertical bar on the far left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the top with extreme tracking in black. Add a second string of text in white, arranged in a perfect circle, positioned over the subject's right shoulder (viewer's left).

verificationChecks: Is the top text tracking wide enough to span the width of the head?
Is the circular text perfectly white against the black clothing?
Is the left-most black bar solid and distinct?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left-side black border
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Specific catalog numbers in the bottom corner
Identifiable facial features of a specific celebrity

mustAchieve: Absolute black and absolute white values

postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not overlap the hair at the top.
Ensure the circular text is legible and follows a smooth arc.
Verify the high-key lighting doesn't lose all facial detail.
Confirm the left black bar is perfectly vertical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key monochrome portrait with a dual-mode typographic system: one horizontal header with extreme tracking and one circular element acting as a graphic badge.
